Here is the U.S. Core Inflation rate (Consumer Price Index less food and energy, 12-month percentage change) from January 2015 through December 2016.

| Month | Core Inflation Rate (%) |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Jan 2015** | 1.6 |
| **Feb 2015** | 1.7 |
| **Mar 2015** | 1.8 |
| **Apr 2015** | 1.8 |
| **May 2015** | 1.7 |
| **Jun 2015** | 1.8 |
| **Jul 2015** | 1.8 |
| **Aug 2015** | 1.8 |
| **Sep 2015** | 1.9 |
| **Oct 2015** | 1.9 |
| **Nov 2015** | 2.0 |
| **Dec 2015** | 2.1 |
| **Jan 2016** | 2.2 |
| **Feb 2016** | 2.3 |
| **Mar 2016** | 2.2 |
| **Apr 2016** | 2.1 |
| **May 2016** | 2.2 |
| **Jun 2016** | 2.3 |
| **Jul 2016** | 2.2 |
| **Aug 2016** | 2.3 |
| **Sep 2016** | 2.2 |
| **Oct 2016** | 2.1 |
| **Nov 2016** | 2.1 |
| **Dec 2016** | 2.2 |

***Note:** Data represents the 12-month percent change for "All items less food and energy" (Core CPI), as reported by the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics.*
